detail_evidence: WIN-037 describes the dome's Domain 8 live panel as monitoring 'against INTERMAGNET Tsumeb only'. Per WIN-042.c4 analysis (curmudgeon 2026-06-06), monitor.py lines 489-497 source the 77.0 nT/yr panel to 'INTERMAGNET TTB annual means' (TTB = Tatuoca, Belem, Brazil) not Tsumeb (TSU, Namibia). Correcting the station attribution to TTB matches what the dome code actually monitors.

tldr_evidence: WIN-042.c4 curmudgeon review (2026-06-06) found the dome's monitor.py attributes the 77.0 nT/yr decay panel to 'INTERMAGNET TTB annual means' (TTB = Tatuoca, Belem, Brazil) while the dome page labels it Tsumeb (TSU, Namibia) — two observatories ~7,800 km apart. WIN-037's detail_verdict_text and detail_evidence inherited this same confusion by naming 'Tsumeb' as the representative SAA-region station. Fix replaces station-specific attribution with SAA-region (for the regional-rate claim) and TTB (for the monitoring-code description).
tldr_verdict: Station attribution corrected: Tsumeb → SAA-region (regional rate claims) and TTB/Tatuoca (dome monitoring code description). Verdict unchanged; text accuracy improved.
